title: ammannia diandra
intro: Ammannia diandra, commonly known as Marshmallow plant, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Lythraceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and providing relief from respiratory problems, such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Ammannia diandra include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular herbal remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
